name: manual_5bec34
claim: When a GitHub Actions resolve step writes GITHUB_OUTPUT via echo inside double quotes that also backslash-quotes GITHUB_HEAD_REF, the sibling-ref resolver receives literal quote characters, misses the stack-map key, and same-named-ref fallback checks out the PT branch name on the peer repo. Diagnose from the checkout fetch refspec in the job log (quoted refs/heads fragments), not from continue-on-error conclusion=success. Write GITHUB_OUTPUT from a --github-output helper; log the input head and resolved peer; checkout the open sibling PR branch until that PR is merged into main, then use main; if a declared peer checkout fails, fail the job instead of silently falling back to main and greenwashing cross-repo parity.

decisions.notes: PT PR #395 CI job 105865624057 (head 8cc3d170 parent dcfb07ce) failed step 13 model-endpoint-policy-parity because step 8 fetched a quoted PT branch on orama-system, then main fallback compared PT tip (no unsafe 127-prefix hostname exception) against orama main. Local resolve against the committed stack map was correct. Fix: unquoted --github-output, merge-aware Orama PR #363 peer (open -> cursor/tiered-pipeline-runtime-fb76, merged -> main), fail declared checkout instead of continue-on-error.
